evidence.field: 女 entry: script-form account, senses and cited examples; scan /home/catalin/hanzi-etymology-books/research-ocr/ziyuan-full/page-1100/source.png
evidence.text: The entry calls 女 pictographic. It describes oracle-bone forms as a woman kneeling with her hands crossed before her chest, and says some forms add a head stroke interpreted as headwear. It describes the kneeling posture as less apparent in Spring and Autumn bronze forms, with Warring States forms following those bronze forms with changed stroke manner; clerical writing turns the vertical kneeling stroke into a horizontal stroke. It gives the core meaning as female, contrasted with 男, and cites a bronze-inscription example and the transmitted 易 for 女 meaning female. It separately reports 女 read as 母 in an oracle-bone example, as 汝 in bronze inscriptions, and as 如 in Warring States writing. The entry also records a distinct nù reading for ‘give a woman in marriage’, citing 國語. These source-reported uses and citations do not by themselves establish a dated semantic development or the dates of each cited inscription.
evidence.title: 字源

evidence.source: 漢字構形資料庫, Academia Sinica
evidence.field: 女: form sequence and interpretation; record lists 合集681正 and 集成09366
evidence.text: The record lists oracle-bone and bronze examples and later Chu, small-seal and 說文 forms. It interprets 女 as a kneeling, seated person with hands crossed. Its further suggestion that this posture reflects women’s usual indoor activities is the database’s cultural interpretation, not established by the listed form sequence. This supports the broad pictographic account, while the social explanation should remain attributed and qualified.
evidence.title: 漢字「女」：字形演變

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
evidence.field: 女: graphic account and reported inscription uses
evidence.text: The entry describes oracle-bone and bronze 女 as a kneeling female figure with hands crossed in front and reports simplification of the seated posture in later bronze forms. It also reports graphic overlap or uses of 女 for 母, 毋, 每/悔, 汝, 如 and place names. These are reported uses, distinct from graphic evolution; the entry does not make them a single dated semantic chain.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 女

evidence.source: 許慎《說文解字》 entry for 女, page reproduced by 說文解字 online
evidence.field: 女 entry quotation; Han-period lexicographic interpretation
evidence.text: The reproduced entry reads 「婦人也。象形。王育說。凡女之屬皆从女。」 This documents the received dictionary gloss ‘woman’ and its pictographic classification; it is not direct evidence for the original Shang depiction or the dating of the lexical sense.
evidence.title: 说文解字：女
